Mender device identity: unique RSA or EC (P-256/Ed25519) key pair per device, Ed25519 default since client 4.1.0, can be pre-provisioned; client initiates all communication so no open ports are needed on the device
Mender Client can load its authentication private key from a PKCS#11 URI (HSM) via OpenSSL engine/provider (SSLEngine option)

Mender artifact signing: RSASSA-PKCS1-v1_5 (>=3072) or ECDSA P-256; ArtifactVerifyKeys allows multiple keys for rotation; unsigned artifacts rejected when verification is on; signing via PKCS#11 HSM, HashiCorp Vault, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault, Keyfactor SignServer

Mender state scripts: ArtifactCommit state commits after reboot, failure triggers ArtifactRollback; exit code 21 = retry later (bounded by StateScriptRetryTimeoutSeconds); power loss transitions to ArtifactRollback or ArtifactFailure and error states repeat until complete
